title: Glass
look: Translucent tinted glass with a bright edge, over colourful blurred blobs.

doc.essence: Frosted, tinted glass: you see the coloured stage through the body, edged with light.
doc.notIt: Not soft-gradient (the body is see-through and edged), not stained glass (no lead).
doc.shapes: A thin white hollow edge around each silhouette; fills fade from a bright corner.
doc.colour: The palette cooled 25 % towards cyan. Stage: three soft colour blobs on navy.
pitfalls: Overlapping translucent parts look darker where they overlap: that is part of the look.
